name: The Journey Has Just Begun
label: Quest
description: In Stormwind, Major Mattingly recognizes the artisan who brought down Onyxia. He teaches the craft needed to make a cloak from her scales.
intro: In Stormwind, Major Mattingly recognizes the artisan who brought down Onyxia. He teaches the craft needed to make a cloak from her scales.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled.
Please accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.
Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... Nefarian.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
